verdicts.reason: Both versions have the same structural problems. The two white bars are pushed out to the extreme top and bottom edges, far from the headline panel, so the original's framing (bars overlapping the dark box) is lost. The headline is far too small for a tall story format, leaving huge empty stretches of blurry, upscaled background above and below. A is worse: its panel is narrower and its headline smaller, so it reads as a shrunk copy. B's wider panel and slightly larger type give the headline a bit more presence, but it is still undersized and floats in dead space.
